patterns.description: Use swallow()/logSwallowed() from packages/api/src/lib/swallow.ts instead of a bare .catch(() => fallback): a swallowed failure must be logged.
Files reading system_settings directly. Reuse an existing settings reader instead of adding another .from('system_settings').
Files reading process.env directly. Read configuration through an existing reader (lib/envValidator.ts, lib/serverEnv.ts) instead of adding another file.
The web matching server error codes by substring. Compare the exact code instead of adding another .includes('PREFIX_...').
Double casts in payment services. Type the value (zod parse or a narrow helper) instead of adding another 'as unknown as'.
